blocks.text: English
为 RPC 的业务值、消息、握手、分片和错误树建立共同的数据边界，让独立载体与语言实现使用同一套线上规则。

items: 校验后的消息还会被外部修改，根因是只保留原对象或浅拷贝，嵌套记录和字节仍共享。
发送前的 NaN 变成了 null，根因是把 JSON 转换结果当成有效业务值。
接收端只有一行错误文字，根因是没有传递原生类型、语义码与原因堆栈。
生成错误诊断时又因 getter 抛错而丢掉整条记录，根因是没有独立报告字段读取失败。
不同对端的同名分片混在一起，根因是重组缓冲只以消息标识作键，没有来源维度。
校验时就捕获独立载荷。 浅拷贝仍别名嵌套记录与字节，normalizePortable 复制记录并生成字节标签，后续外部修改不改变快照 运行证明。
不把非法数字悄悄替换成合法值。 JSON 会把 NaN 改成 null，而 portable 遍历检查全部后代并明确拒绝非有限数与环 运行证明。
跨边界仍能辨认原始错误链。 只发送 message 会丢失类型和堆栈，错误树工具保留语义码、原生类和发送方的原因堆栈 运行证明。
被省略的错误字段也有诊断依据。 直接读取可能让异常逃出日志，serializeRpcError 通过必填 report 交出原读取失败并继续生成受大小限制的错误树 运行证明。
相同消息标识按来源隔离。 仅按 messageId 存缓冲会混合对端数据，framer 用来源与消息标识共同保存组装状态 运行证明。

blocks.text: 先捕获一份载荷，再修改调用者对象；本例只做本地规范化，不发送请求。value 必填，未传 depth/active 时从深度 0 开始使用本次祖先集合。

blocks.code:
import { normalizePortable } from '@migaia/rpc-contract/portable'

const source = { profile: { name: 'Ada' }, bytes: new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3]) }
const snapshot = normalizePortable(source)
source.profile.name = 'Grace'
source.bytes[0] = 99
console.log(JSON.stringify(snapshot))
console.log(Object.isFrozen(snapshot))

blocks.text: 输出：

blocks.code:
{"profile":{"name":"Ada"},"bytes":{"$rpc":"bytes","base64url":"AQID"}}
true

blocks.text: 遇到数值悄悄变更，看显式拒绝非法值；遇到远端错误只剩文字，看保留类型与原因堆栈。
原生 JSON 可以编码数据，但不会替你建立这个协议的值域与快照边界。以下只展示隐患，进行类型检查，不运行：

blocks.code:
const source = { profile: { name: 'Ada' }, bytes: new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3]) }
const snapshot = { ...source } // 隐患：浅拷贝仍共享 profile 和字节数组，后续修改会改变载荷。
const text = JSON.stringify({ ...snapshot, total: Number.NaN }) // 隐患：NaN 被替换为 null，值域问题被掩盖。
const received = JSON.parse(text) as typeof source // 隐患：类型断言不校验记录，也不会还原二进制含义。
void received

blocks.text: normalizePortable 先按共同规则捕获与校验，再交给后续 codec 或载体。若只是本地 JSON 文档且接受其转换语义，原生操作本身即可使用。

rows: 捕获可跨语言表示的业务值

载体只提供任意切块字节

runtime / stream / binary 分层入口

blocks.text: “portable”是协议能明确表示的值域；“信封”是在载荷外附加种类与路由的记录；“framer”划定消息边界并组装分片；“source”是载体告诉分帧器的来源标识；“codec”负责数据与编码值之间转换；“sidecar”是清单之外随消息发送的原生二进制。以上工具不等于连接、认证或调用执行器。

rows: 在调用者修改前捕获数据
拒绝在线上传输时会失去原意的值
保留原生错误类型与远端原因堆栈
报告不可读字段并继续生成线上错误

拒绝乱序分片并关闭未完成组装

blocks.text: 本包定义 RPC 的线上格式并提供数据构造、校验、规范化与分帧函数。它不打开连接、不执行远程方法、不拥有 Endpoint，也不绑定 Node、DOM 或 Worker。状态型 framer 只拥有有界重组缓存及 assembly expiry 计时器。运行时依赖仅 `@migaia/serialize` 与 `@migaia/utils`，没有 peer 依赖。
普通 TS 调用方通常通过 rpc-core 使用它；rpc-core 将它列为 peer 依赖。独立语言对端、载体适配器和跨边界错误处理才需要直接使用这些入口。rpc-process 复用 Content-Length 分帧及错误转换；serialize 提供底层可移植遍历与错误链实现。

rows: 常量、V1 信封、握手、portable 与错误工具
线上常量和类型，也含 measurePortableStreamValue 等纯数据操作

字符串/二进制消息分片、重组、物理帧检查
四字节大端长度前缀及 bootstrap/handshake 接收器
Content-Length 字节分帧及桥错误码

流负载、序号、进度、额度和控制状态检查

blocks.text: 以上共根入口及 18 个子入口，最后一项是 JSON 文件。不要导入内部文件。`./v1` 使用具名 rpcProtocol 与 normalizeRpcEnvelope，没有 default 聚合；根入口以 rpcProtocolV1 提供该协议对象。`createReassembler` / `IRpcReassembler` 已移除，直接使用原 framer.accept/close，或 Pick 相应方法类型。完整字符串统一用 remoteProcessStringFramer，bare processStringFramer 不再公开，没有兼容别名。

sections.id: 常量-描述符与线上格式
sections.heading: 常量、描述符与线上格式

blocks.text: `RpcProtocol` 给出协议标识 `migaia.rpc` 与当前 major/minor `1.1`。`RpcCodecId` 维护 codec 名称，如 json；`RpcCapability` 维护带版本能力名，如 ping@1、batch@1、stream@1、runtime-api@1、group@1、transfer@1。独立实现应使用同一线上值，不自行拼接另一套字符串。

`RpcPeerRuntime` 有 node、bun、deno、electron、python、rust、go、java 等标签键；合法 runtime 字符串 browser 不等于存在同名常量键。`RpcEnvelopeKind`、`RpcRouteField/Key/Profile/Type`、`RpcWireLimit`、`RpcStreamLimit`、`RpcWireErrorLimit` 维护信封、路由与预算词汇。路由字段包括 timeoutMs、idempotencyKey、trace 等；`RpcRuntime*` 描述 runtime 调用，二进制标签 `RpcBinaryTag` 从 wire 入口导入，binary 子入口公开 profile/storage/native-kind 等域。
`createDescriptor(id, version)` 返回冻结的精确身份对象；id 和正安全整数 version 必填，无默认，非法描述符为 TypeError / INVALID_DESCRIPTOR。描述符不会建立连接或登记服务。
普通 `normalizePortable(value, depth?, active?)` 使用 wire 域；value 必填，depth 默认 0，active 默认由遍历创建的祖先集合，不是全局对象去重表。`RPC_PORTABLE_MAX_DEPTH` 为 64。相同对象在不同分支出现会各自得到副本，只有当前祖先链回边是循环。

rows: null、布尔、字符串、有限数（包括 -0）
普通或 null 原型对象
冻结的 null 原型副本，按自有可枚举字符串键读取，每字段一次

blocks.text: 属性值为 undefined 也会拒绝。保留的 `$rpc` 标记只用于严格合法的 bytes 标签；非法字母、填充或非 canonical 尾位不是合法字节标签。Uint8Array 通过真实内部字节品牌判断，可接受跨 realm 和合法子类，不因伪造 toStringTag 就接纳 DataView 或伪视图。
普通 wire 遍历会执行对象 getter，并仅捕获一次；不要把它与下面 runtime 的严格 own-data 校验混为一谈。反射或 getter 失败保留原因为 cause。带 native guard 的高级重载在二进制准入点以无 receiver 方式调用 guard，原失败保持身份；普通业务代码无需手动维护 active 或 guard。
协商后的 runtime native-binary 分支有独立重载，可保留 ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array 身份，并要求严格自有 data 描述符；这不扩大默认 wire normalizer 的返回域。ArrayBuffer 的跨对端传输由二进制 profile 处理，不能把它直接塞进普通 portable 数据。

sections.heading: 握手：本地 offer 与对端文本

blocks.text: 发起方 createRpcHello(offer) 返回要发送的 JSON 文本；响应方 acceptRpcHandshake(localOffer, hello) 选共同参数并返回 `{ ok, reply, agreement? , error? }`；发起方 completeRpcHandshake(localOffer, reply) 确认 agreement。normalizeRpcHandshake(text) 只校验收到的握手文本；函数不负责实际收发或认证。

offer 包括 peer、versions、codecs、capabilities；peer.id/runtime 描述本端，versions 每项为 major/minor，codecs 必须含 json 并按偏好排列，capabilities 为唯一的带版本能力列表，空表表示不提议可选能力。可选 auth 携带凭据，由上层认证；有 auth 字段不等于认证已成功。规范化后的 agreement.peer 指向对端：响应方看发起方，发起方看响应方。

协商选最高共同主版本，次版本取双方较小者，codec 按发起方顺序选首个共同项，能力取交集并保留发起方顺序。无共同版本或 codec 时响应方返回 ok false 和可发送的 reject reply；发起方收到拒绝抛 HANDSHAKE_REJECTED，cause 可保留 HANDSHAKE_INCOMPATIBLE。非法 UTF-8、JSON、字段或选择结果为 HANDSHAKE_INVALID，不能自动降级为旧协议。
握手错误的公开 cause 可能是有界、冻结的脱敏摘要，不会无条件保留包含凭据的原始文本、对象或引擎 JSON 摘录。可确认安全的原生 decoder/getter 错误仍保持原身份。独立适配器应按 source/code 处理，不依赖未经脱敏的输入回显。
原生长度前缀与 JSON-RPC Content-Length 是两种不同格式，不可混用：

rows: 四字节无符号大端长度 + payload
encodeRpcStreamFrame 编码，createRpcStreamFrameDecoder 通过 onFrame 交付、onError 报首个协议错误并终止
encodeJsonRpcFrame 编码，createJsonRpcFrameDecoder.push 返回本轮完整值数组，非法 push/finish 直接抛桥错误

blocks.text: 长度前缀 encoder 的 payload 必须为非空 Uint8Array，最大 `RPC_STREAM_MAX_FRAME_BYTES` 为 16 MiB；空或非法负载为 INVALID_FRAME，超限为 FRAME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED。decoder 的 options 必填，onFrame(frame) 和 onError(error) 都必填、无默认；push 接收任意切块，复制输入到自身帧内存以免调用方复用 chunk。finish 检查残留半帧，结束此 decoder；close 丢弃状态。onFrame 中 close/finish 会停止当前 chunk 剩余交付。
createRpcStreamFrameDecoderWithLimit(options, maxFrameBytes) 在每帧分配前读取当前上限，适用于握手阶段小预算；callback 与预算函数由调用方提供。createRpcBootstrapFrameReceiver/createRpcHandshakeFrameReceiver 用于激活前处理第一帧与排队后续数据，不拥有连接。

JSON-RPC encoder 按 UTF-8 实际字节写 Content-Length，而非 JS 字符串长度。decoder 无构造参数，push(chunk) 可收到任意边界，返回零条或多条完整消息；bufferedBytes 反映保留的字节。JsonRpcLimit 的 headerBytes 为 1024，bodyBytes 为 16 MiB，handshakeMs 为 10000。非法头部、重复/缺失长度、非法 UTF-8 或 JSON、半帧 EOF 为 JSONRPC_FRAME_INVALID。这里 finish 只检查残留，不关闭 decoder；close 才清空且使后续 push 返回空数组。不要套用长度前缀 decoder 的 onError/终止语义。

sections.heading: 消息 framer 与重组所有权

blocks.text: createStringFramer(options?) 与 createBinaryFramer(options?) 产生 descriptor、输入/输出 encoded 类型、frame(value, context)、accept(frame, context)、close(reason?)。context 的 source 与 messageId 必填；source 由载体边界提供，用来隔离不同来源的同名消息。frame 返回物理帧数组；accept 返回 pending、complete/value 或 rejected/error，不是为拒绝结果一概抛错。
options 默认空对象，其数字字段均须为正安全整数：

chunkBytes 不可大于 maxMessageBytes，后者不可大于 maxBufferedBytes。schedule(callback, delayMs) 与 cancel(handle) 可由调用方注入，省略时使用宿主可用的 setTimeout/clearTimeout；宿主无 timer 时不会凭空创建计时能力。now 字段只读取保留，不驱动组装期限；单独改变 fake now 不会推进计时器。framer 拥有并释放自己的 timer，调用方使用后应 close。完整载体和分片都执行 maxMessageBytes；字符串沿用 UTF-16 code unit 计量，二进制按 byteLength。不能把字符串预算当作真实 UTF-8 物理大小；编码后尺寸检查另用 inspectRpcPhysicalFrame(value, limit)。
分片严格要求首片、顺序、数量与长度匹配，迟到、重复、超限或到期会被拒绝。重组以 source/messageId 二元组隔离，不能靠含分隔符的简单拼接猜身份。没有显式网络发送，调用方负责按 accept 结果决定后续处理。

计时器先从 owner 脱离再取消，重入 close 不重复取消。schedule/warn 未分类回调失败附 CALLBACK_FAILED；cancel 失败经可用宿主 reportError 或 utils 宿主异常队列观察，保留 primary 与 reporter secondary，不替换已产生的帧结果。inspectRpcPhysicalFrame 按实际编码帧测量；可拆批次用 splitBatch 对半拆分，单条超限以 RangeError 拒绝。
remoteProcessStringFramer 用于每次已交付完整字符串的载体，保留消息边界且不再分片；非字符串为 TypeError / INVALID_FRAME。

sections.heading: runtime、stream 与 Decoded 信任边界

blocks.text: normalizeRuntimeEnvelope(value) 校验收到的 runtime 信封，严格读取自有 data 属性，拒绝访问器而不执行 getter。runtime request/notify/stream/group 的元数据词汇在 runtime 入口维护；createRuntimeCallEnvelope 从 runtime/metadata 构造出站调用头，normalizeRuntimeGeneration/normalizeRuntimeSteps 校验代次与 group 步骤。steps 须为非空、稠密的 own-data 数组，没有独立固定步数上限，物理字节预算另管。

normalizeRuntimeEnvelopeDecoded、restoreRpcBinaryDecoded 只用于本库 codec 刚输出、未经过其它代码的对象。它们保持相同数据规则、首错与冻结元数据，但省去完整属性描述符检查，可能执行自行构造对象上的 getter。它们仍检查普通原型，structuredClone 保留的 Date/Map 不能因此被当作记录。未知来源用严格版本，不要把 Decoded 作为公开信任开关。runtime/lazy 的 scalar 分支可同步返回，stream 分支可返回 Promise，调用方应支持两种返回域。

stream 入口的 normalizeStreamPayload 校验负载；checkRpcStreamSequence/Progress/ConsumerCredit/ProducerCredit 检查连续序号、进度、消费者额度与生产者忙碌状态。合法返回 undefined，协议违规返回带 code 的 Error，由调用方选择报告、终止或取消，不把返回值当作已经自动抛错。checkRpcRuntimeStreamTransition/Intent 校验结束与提前控制是否符合起始选项。它们不调度生产者、不发送数据，也不重放已交付项。

prepareRpcBinary(envelope, storage, limit?, digest?, codec?) 生成二进制清单、sidecar 与总量；restoreRpcBinary 校验清单与完整性后还原，Decoded 版有前述信任限制。captureRpcBinaryData 同步捕获，稍后 prepare，适用于捕获时间早于编码；binary/lazy 同名操作在完整 codec 加载前捕获数据，并在需要摘要的 native 分支计算首个摘要。

native 按完整底层 ArrayBuffer 计入 backing 预算；inline 按 offset + visibleLength 计入分配预算，只复制可见字节并保留零前缀语义。limit 不无条件覆盖清单全部元数据。native + encode-only codec 的 prehash 分支另查实际整帧，inline 或其他 codec 的物理帧上限由对应 codec 或调用者负责。

digest 参数可省略；选择 native 存储时必须由调用方提供覆盖完整 backing 的真实 SHA-256，不能用占位摘要替代，inline 不需要 digest。limit 省略时默认 16 MiB，还原时 sidecars 默认空数组 []。可选末参 codec 提供元数据编码。binary/inspect 的 assertRpcNativeBinaryFrameSize 等按完整 backing 检查帧大小、读取原生二进制并分类完整性错误。这些函数不负责选择载体、传输或释放对端资源。

sections.id: 错误树-原生类型与-json-rpc-转换
sections.heading: 错误树、原生类型与 JSON-RPC 转换

blocks.text: serializeRpcError(value, options, metadata?) 的 value 和 options.report 必填；report 接收 `{ pointer, field, error }`，用于被跳过的属性读取或数据规范化失败，不能用次数统计全部截断。它按 source、code、name、message、stack，加可选 cause/errors/data/route/truncated 输出有界错误树；无身份错误使用 unknown/UNKNOWN。跨 realm 原生类型名和发送方 stack 被保留，deserializeRpcError 校验后还原 Error、RangeError、TypeError 等类型，不重新制造发送方 stack。

RpcWireErrorLimit：maxNesting 48、maxEmbeddingDepth 16、maxNodes 1024、maxStringBytes 65536、maxBytes 1048576。超预算或文本截断会裁掉内容并标 truncated；不保证每次裁剪都 report。循环边被裁去；reachRpcError(value, { report }) 遍历 cause、errors 与 cleanup 错误并按引用去重，RpcErrorReachLimit.maxObjects 为 4096。

normalizeRpcSerializedError(value, options?) 的 options 默认空对象；unknownFields 为 reject（默认）或 ignore，onUnknownField 可选、无默认 callback。deserializeRpcError(value, options?, routes?) 采用相同规则，routes 可接调用方 WeakMap 的 set 能力保存已接纳路由。序列化读取固定字段，某字段 getter 失败可报告并保留根、设置 truncated；不承诺读取错误对象的所有任意自有属性。
第三参数 metadata 的 summaries/routes 都可选，是按 Error 引用查询的 WeakMap get 能力。summaries 可给 code/message 对外摘要并隐藏内部 cause；preserveSerializedError: true 才保留该节点既有后代。routes 提供有界路由诊断，不授予控制权限。

toJsonRpcError(wire, code) 把错误树放入 error.data.migaiaWireError；整数 code 由调用方选定，不默认等于 wire code。fromJsonRpcError 也接受无扩展的普通 JSON-RPC 错误，使用 foreignSource `jsonrpc-2.0` 与整数 code 的字符串。RpcJsonRpcWireError.dataKey 维护扩展键。独立适配器使用自己的 source/code，可直接安装 utils 并用 attachErrorIdentity 保留原生错误；不要冒用官方 RPC 身份。
classifyRpcContractError(error) 只按本地对象引用识别本包签发错误，返回对外 code/message；复制或远端还原的错误返回 undefined。远端 source/code 是诊断身份，不证明本地来源，也不授予重试或控制权。

schema/wire-error 只提供结构校验起点，不等于有界 normalizer。独立实现还须执行 x-migaia-limits、canonical base64url、surrogate 等规则；Schema 的 additionalProperties 与 normalizer 默认 reject 并不等价。用其它语言实现原生对端还需长度前缀、握手和 runtime 信封；JSON-RPC 桥还需其四个扩展方法，由 rpc-process 的协议层负责，不由本包完成连接。
本包错误的语义来源 `source` 为 `@migaia/rpc/contract`，由常量 `RPC_CONTRACT_SOURCE` 表示，code 来自 RpcContractErrorCode：

rows: 默认 Error，原生回调失败保留其类；warn/schedule/cancel 等未分类回调失败，原错或 cause 保留
TypeError；描述符身份或配置非法
TypeError；信封或 portable 业务值非法
TypeError；流字段、序号、额度或值非法
RangeError；帧语法、空负载或物理批次非法
TypeError；错误树非法，可能带 pointer/violation/cause
TypeError；握手编码、JSON 或字段非法
Error；版本、codec 或所需能力不兼容
Error；对端拒绝，检查受控 cause

blocks.text: 形状失败保留对应原生类；可写回调错误原位附码且不改 stack，不可写或非 Error 值经 cause，完整外包 source/code 保留原 owner。fatal UTF-8 decoder 失败在 HANDSHAKE_INVALID/INVALID_FRAME 的 cause 中保留。

JSON-RPC 桥身份为 `@migaia/rpc/bridge/jsonrpc`（JSONRPC_BRIDGE_ERROR_SOURCE），其 JsonRpcBridgeErrorCode 包括 JSONRPC_FRAME_INVALID、JSONRPC_EXTENSION_MISSING、JSONRPC_PROFILE_INVALID、JSONRPC_UNSUPPORTED_MODE、JSONRPC_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT，分别用于分帧、缺扩展、profile、模式和握手期限。不要把桥错误当作 contract source。

其他层的 source 分别是 rpc-core 的 `@migaia/rpc/core`（RPC_CORE_ERROR_SOURCE / RpcCoreErrorCode）、rpc-core/remote 的 `@migaia/rpc/remote`（RPC_REMOTE_ERROR_SOURCE / RpcRemoteLayerErrorCode）、rpc-process 的 `@migaia/rpc/process`（RPC_PROCESS_ERROR_SOURCE / RpcProcessErrorCode）与 rpc-threads 的 `@migaia/rpc/threads`（RPC_THREAD_ERROR_SOURCE / RpcThreadErrorCode）。按 source/code 分支；message 用于展示，不用于决定重试。

blocks.text: 每段代码与网站同名场景相同，可独立运行，不需要打开连接。先安装本包：

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/rpc-contract

sections.id: 在调用者修改前捕获数据
sections.heading: 在调用者修改前捕获数据

blocks.text: 适配器校验载荷后，调用者在编码前又修改了嵌套对象或字节数组，消息应保留校验边界接纳的值。
保留原对象会让后续修改改变发送内容，浅层展开仍共享嵌套记录与字节，无法建立稳定的载荷快照。
`normalizePortable` 创建冻结的可移植快照，默认线上形态复制记录，并把 `Uint8Array` 字节转成规范的不带填充 Base64URL 标签，不会发送请求。
`normalizePortable(value)` 的 value 必填；本例 profile/name 和 bytes 都是业务数据，不是 RPC 端点字段。未传 depth/active 时深度从 0 开始并使用本次祖先集合；原 Uint8Array 的可见字节转成无填充 base64url 标签，默认不保留原数组身份。

blocks.code:
import { normalizePortable } from '@migaia/rpc-contract/portable'

const source = { profile: { name: 'Ada' }, bytes: new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3]) }
const snapshot = normalizePortable(source)
source.profile.name = 'Grace'
source.bytes[0] = 99
console.log(JSON.stringify(snapshot))
console.log(Object.isFrozen(snapshot))

blocks.text: 输出：

blocks.code:
{"profile":{"name":"Ada"},"bytes":{"$rpc":"bytes","base64url":"AQID"}}
true

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `{"profile":{"name":"Ada"},"bytes":{"$rpc":"bytes","base64url":"AQID"}}`、`true`，后续修改没有改变已捕获的名字或字节编码。
普通记录变成冻结的空原型快照，默认形态产出字节标签，不会恢复为 `Uint8Array`；协商后的原生二进制另有契约，普通线上记录的访问器会读取一次并可能执行用户代码。

sections.id: 拒绝在线上传输时会失去原意的值
sections.heading: 拒绝在线上传输时会失去原意的值

blocks.text: 非有限计量值可能被悄悄保存为 `null`，带环载荷则无法形成有限线上树，两者都应在适配器决定发送消息前拒绝。
`JSON.stringify` 会把记录里的 `NaN` 改成 `null`，只检查顶层对象又会漏掉深处的非法后代与环。
`normalizePortable` 遍历支持的值树并拒绝非法后代，对照 JSON 结果与带分类的 `TypeError`，再用同一公开入口接收另一个带环对象。
两次 value 均必填，分别是含 NaN 的记录和自引用对象；未传高级选项。默认只接纳有限数，根深度 0，最大深度 64，数据不合法时抛 TypeError 并附 INVALID_ENVELOPE。
输出：
逐行输出 `{"total":null}`、`非有限值: true INVALID_ENVELOPE`、`循环: true INVALID_ENVELOPE`，校验没有替换非法数字，也没有接纳递归引用。
默认值域含 `null`、布尔、有限数、字符串、数组、普通记录及可移植字节，根深度为 `0`，最大深度 `64`；不接纳 `Date`、`Map`、`Set`、函数及其他不支持的原始值。

sections.id: 保留原生错误类型与远端原因堆栈
sections.heading: 保留原生错误类型与远端原因堆栈

blocks.text: 远端操作因范围错误而抛出类型错误，接收方需要两层语义码和原始堆栈，才能辨认失败操作及根因。
只发送错误消息会丢掉原因树、原生类型与堆栈，用该文字在本地重建错误，又会生成接收端堆栈并掩盖原始失败位置。
`serializeRpcError` 投影有界带码树，`deserializeRpcError` 校验后恢复原生类型，须提供 `report` 回调以保留无法读取或规范化字段的失败。
`serializeRpcError(value, options)` 两项必填；options.report 是必填同步回调，本例把每个失败记录放入 reports，没有额外默认报告器。source/code 是错误的语义身份，cause 是原始原因。deserializeRpcError 的 options 可省略，未知字段默认 reject。
输出：

blocks.code:
true true
true true
REQUEST LIMIT 0

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `true true`、`true true`、`REQUEST LIMIT 0`，往返保留两种原生类型、两份堆栈字符串和语义码，未报告字段失败。
恢复会创建新的错误对象，不保留跨边界对象身份；错误树有界，可携带 `cause`、聚合错误子项和截断标记，这些函数不建立连接或执行请求。

sections.id: 报告不可读字段并继续生成线上错误
sections.heading: 报告不可读字段并继续生成线上错误

blocks.text: 诊断序列化遇到消息访问器会抛错的错误对象，丢弃整条诊断会同时掩盖原操作与新的字段读取失败。
构建 JSON 对象时直接读取属性，会让访问器异常逃出日志路径，若忽略该异常，又会丢失字段被省略的依据。
`serializeRpcError` 捕获支持字段，并把被省略的读取失败交给 `report`；本例先保存错误堆栈，再设置会抛错的消息访问器，收集报告记录供检查。
options.report 的 entry 包含 pointer、field、error；本例 error 是 message getter 的原始失败。第三参数 metadata 未提供，不启用调用方摘要或路由表。Object.defineProperty 是构造本地失败样本，不是 normalizer 的配置项。
输出：

blocks.code:
Error UNKNOWN
1 message true

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `Error UNKNOWN`、`1 message true`，仍返回线上错误，报告指出不可读的消息字段并保留原始 `TypeError`。
`report` 必填，同步收到指针、字段和原始失败；这些记录是本地诊断依据，不是额外线上字段，未编码错误使用未知来源与错误码兜底，不可读字段遵守有界序列化策略。

sections.id: 隔离不同对端的相同消息标识
sections.heading: 隔离不同对端的相同消息标识

blocks.text: 两个对端分别发送标识为 `job` 的分片消息，分片可能交错，但完成一条消息时不能拼入另一个对端的数据。
只用 `messageId` 建缓冲表会合并无关发送方，即使分片有序也可能得到看似合法的错误组合，或消费另一个发送方的组装状态。
`createStringFramer` 共同使用 `source` 与 `messageId` 保存组装状态，把 `chunkBytes` 设为 `2`，交错接收两条首片，再分别完成并关闭分帧器。
options 可选、默认空对象；本例仅把 chunkBytes 从默认 16384 改成 2，字符串按 UTF-16 码元计数。context.source 和 context.messageId 均必填、无默认；两个来源共享 job 标识。frame/accept 的值和 context 均必填，close 的 reason 可选。
输出：

blocks.code:
pending pending
abcd
wxyz

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `pending pending`、`abcd`、`wxyz`，相同消息标识的两条部分组装可并存，完成结果分别只含自身来源的数据。
调用者负责可信来源归属和消息关联，分片数据不认证对端；字符串形态虽用 `chunkBytes` 名称，实际按 UTF-16 码元计数，要求有序交付，并通过 `close()` 释放保留计时器。

sections.id: 拒绝乱序分片并关闭未完成组装
sections.heading: 拒绝乱序分片并关闭未完成组装

blocks.text: 接收器先看到第二片，随后只取得前缀便关闭，需要明确的拒绝结果，也需要释放未完成组装的方式。
按到达顺序直接拼接会形成乱序载荷，关闭后继续保存前缀则让缓冲与超时归属超出接收器生命周期。
`createStringFramer.accept` 返回 `pending`、`complete` 或 `rejected`；先提交乱序片，再接收合法首片，随后关闭并再次接收，观察接收终态边界。
本例沿用 chunkBytes: 2 及必填 source/messageId。accept 返回 pending、complete/value 或 rejected/error；它不会重排分片。close(reason?) 省略 reason 时为 undefined，清理后拒绝后续接收；其余容量与时限保持下文表中的默认值。
输出：

blocks.code:
rejected INVALID_FRAME
pending
rejected INVALID_FRAME

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `rejected INVALID_FRAME`、`pending`、`rejected INVALID_FRAME`，过早的第二片被拒绝，合法前缀之后的关闭也阻止继续接收。
非法入站分片返回带分类的拒绝结果，非法构造限制则抛错；`close()` 清理组装与计时器，此分帧器不负责重排或重试，消息大小、分片数与并发限制仍然生效。
本包定义 RPC 的线上格式并提供数据构造、校验、规范化与分帧函数。它不打开连接、不执行远程方法、不拥有 Endpoint，也不绑定 Node、DOM 或 Worker。状态型 framer 只拥有有界重组缓存及 assembly expiry 计时器。运行时依赖仅 `@migaia/serialize` 与 `@migaia/utils`，没有 peer 依赖。
普通 TS 调用方通常通过 rpc-core 使用它；rpc-core 将它列为 peer 依赖。独立语言对端、载体适配器和跨边界错误处理才需要直接使用这些入口。rpc-process 复用 Content-Length 分帧及错误转换；serialize 提供底层可移植遍历与错误链实现。

sections.id: 常量-描述符与线上格式
sections.heading: 常量、描述符与线上格式

blocks.text: `RpcProtocol` 给出协议标识 `migaia.rpc` 与当前 major/minor `1.1`。`RpcCodecId` 维护 codec 名称，如 json；`RpcCapability` 维护带版本能力名，如 ping@1、batch@1、stream@1、runtime-api@1、group@1、transfer@1。独立实现应使用同一线上值，不自行拼接另一套字符串。

`RpcPeerRuntime` 有 node、bun、deno、electron、python、rust、go、java 等标签键；合法 runtime 字符串 browser 不等于存在同名常量键。`RpcEnvelopeKind`、`RpcRouteField/Key/Profile/Type`、`RpcWireLimit`、`RpcStreamLimit`、`RpcWireErrorLimit` 维护信封、路由与预算词汇。路由字段包括 timeoutMs、idempotencyKey、trace 等；`RpcRuntime*` 描述 runtime 调用，二进制标签 `RpcBinaryTag` 从 wire 入口导入，binary 子入口公开 profile/storage/native-kind 等域。
`createDescriptor(id, version)` 返回冻结的精确身份对象；id 和正安全整数 version 必填，无默认，非法描述符为 TypeError / INVALID_DESCRIPTOR。描述符不会建立连接或登记服务。
普通 `normalizePortable(value, depth?, active?)` 使用 wire 域；value 必填，depth 默认 0，active 默认由遍历创建的祖先集合，不是全局对象去重表。`RPC_PORTABLE_MAX_DEPTH` 为 64。相同对象在不同分支出现会各自得到副本，只有当前祖先链回边是循环。

rows: null、布尔、字符串、有限数（包括 -0）
普通或 null 原型对象
冻结的 null 原型副本，按自有可枚举字符串键读取，每字段一次

blocks.text: 属性值为 undefined 也会拒绝。保留的 `$rpc` 标记只用于严格合法的 bytes 标签；非法字母、填充或非 canonical 尾位不是合法字节标签。Uint8Array 通过真实内部字节品牌判断，可接受跨 realm 和合法子类，不因伪造 toStringTag 就接纳 DataView 或伪视图。
普通 wire 遍历会执行对象 getter，并仅捕获一次；不要把它与下面 runtime 的严格 own-data 校验混为一谈。反射或 getter 失败保留原因为 cause。带 native guard 的高级重载在二进制准入点以无 receiver 方式调用 guard，原失败保持身份；普通业务代码无需手动维护 active 或 guard。
协商后的 runtime native-binary 分支有独立重载，可保留 ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array 身份，并要求严格自有 data 描述符；这不扩大默认 wire normalizer 的返回域。ArrayBuffer 的跨对端传输由二进制 profile 处理，不能把它直接塞进普通 portable 数据。

sections.heading: 握手：本地 offer 与对端文本

blocks.text: 发起方 createRpcHello(offer) 返回要发送的 JSON 文本；响应方 acceptRpcHandshake(localOffer, hello) 选共同参数并返回 `{ ok, reply, agreement? , error? }`；发起方 completeRpcHandshake(localOffer, reply) 确认 agreement。normalizeRpcHandshake(text) 只校验收到的握手文本；函数不负责实际收发或认证。

offer 包括 peer、versions、codecs、capabilities；peer.id/runtime 描述本端，versions 每项为 major/minor，codecs 必须含 json 并按偏好排列，capabilities 为唯一的带版本能力列表，空表表示不提议可选能力。可选 auth 携带凭据，由上层认证；有 auth 字段不等于认证已成功。规范化后的 agreement.peer 指向对端：响应方看发起方，发起方看响应方。

协商选最高共同主版本，次版本取双方较小者，codec 按发起方顺序选首个共同项，能力取交集并保留发起方顺序。无共同版本或 codec 时响应方返回 ok false 和可发送的 reject reply；发起方收到拒绝抛 HANDSHAKE_REJECTED，cause 可保留 HANDSHAKE_INCOMPATIBLE。非法 UTF-8、JSON、字段或选择结果为 HANDSHAKE_INVALID，不能自动降级为旧协议。
握手错误的公开 cause 可能是有界、冻结的脱敏摘要，不会无条件保留包含凭据的原始文本、对象或引擎 JSON 摘录。可确认安全的原生 decoder/getter 错误仍保持原身份。独立适配器应按 source/code 处理，不依赖未经脱敏的输入回显。
原生长度前缀与 JSON-RPC Content-Length 是两种不同格式，不可混用：

rows: 四字节无符号大端长度 + payload
encodeRpcStreamFrame 编码，createRpcStreamFrameDecoder 通过 onFrame 交付、onError 报首个协议错误并终止
encodeJsonRpcFrame 编码，createJsonRpcFrameDecoder.push 返回本轮完整值数组，非法 push/finish 直接抛桥错误

blocks.text: 长度前缀 encoder 的 payload 必须为非空 Uint8Array，最大 `RPC_STREAM_MAX_FRAME_BYTES` 为 16 MiB；空或非法负载为 INVALID_FRAME，超限为 FRAME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED。decoder 的 options 必填，onFrame(frame) 和 onError(error) 都必填、无默认；push 接收任意切块，复制输入到自身帧内存以免调用方复用 chunk。finish 检查残留半帧，结束此 decoder；close 丢弃状态。onFrame 中 close/finish 会停止当前 chunk 剩余交付。
createRpcStreamFrameDecoderWithLimit(options, maxFrameBytes) 在每帧分配前读取当前上限，适用于握手阶段小预算；callback 与预算函数由调用方提供。createRpcBootstrapFrameReceiver/createRpcHandshakeFrameReceiver 用于激活前处理第一帧与排队后续数据，不拥有连接。

JSON-RPC encoder 按 UTF-8 实际字节写 Content-Length，而非 JS 字符串长度。decoder 无构造参数，push(chunk) 可收到任意边界，返回零条或多条完整消息；bufferedBytes 反映保留的字节。JsonRpcLimit 的 headerBytes 为 1024，bodyBytes 为 16 MiB，handshakeMs 为 10000。非法头部、重复/缺失长度、非法 UTF-8 或 JSON、半帧 EOF 为 JSONRPC_FRAME_INVALID。这里 finish 只检查残留，不关闭 decoder；close 才清空且使后续 push 返回空数组。不要套用长度前缀 decoder 的 onError/终止语义。

sections.heading: 消息 framer 与重组所有权

blocks.text: createStringFramer(options?) 与 createBinaryFramer(options?) 产生 descriptor、输入/输出 encoded 类型、frame(value, context)、accept(frame, context)、close(reason?)。context 的 source 与 messageId 必填；source 由载体边界提供，用来隔离不同来源的同名消息。frame 返回物理帧数组；accept 返回 pending、complete/value 或 rejected/error，不是为拒绝结果一概抛错。
options 默认空对象，其数字字段均须为正安全整数：

chunkBytes 不可大于 maxMessageBytes，后者不可大于 maxBufferedBytes。schedule(callback, delayMs) 与 cancel(handle) 可由调用方注入，省略时使用宿主可用的 setTimeout/clearTimeout；宿主无 timer 时不会凭空创建计时能力。now 字段只读取保留，不驱动组装期限；单独改变 fake now 不会推进计时器。framer 拥有并释放自己的 timer，调用方使用后应 close。完整载体和分片都执行 maxMessageBytes；字符串沿用 UTF-16 code unit 计量，二进制按 byteLength。不能把字符串预算当作真实 UTF-8 物理大小；编码后尺寸检查另用 inspectRpcPhysicalFrame(value, limit)。
分片严格要求首片、顺序、数量与长度匹配，迟到、重复、超限或到期会被拒绝。重组以 source/messageId 二元组隔离，不能靠含分隔符的简单拼接猜身份。没有显式网络发送，调用方负责按 accept 结果决定后续处理。

计时器先从 owner 脱离再取消，重入 close 不重复取消。schedule/warn 未分类回调失败附 CALLBACK_FAILED；cancel 失败经可用宿主 reportError 或 utils 宿主异常队列观察，保留 primary 与 reporter secondary，不替换已产生的帧结果。inspectRpcPhysicalFrame 按实际编码帧测量；可拆批次用 splitBatch 对半拆分，单条超限以 RangeError 拒绝。
remoteProcessStringFramer 用于每次已交付完整字符串的载体，保留消息边界且不再分片；非字符串为 TypeError / INVALID_FRAME。

sections.heading: runtime、stream 与 Decoded 信任边界

blocks.text: normalizeRuntimeEnvelope(value) 校验收到的 runtime 信封，严格读取自有 data 属性，拒绝访问器而不执行 getter。runtime request/notify/stream/group 的元数据词汇在 runtime 入口维护；createRuntimeCallEnvelope 从 runtime/metadata 构造出站调用头，normalizeRuntimeGeneration/normalizeRuntimeSteps 校验代次与 group 步骤。steps 须为非空、稠密的 own-data 数组，没有独立固定步数上限，物理字节预算另管。

normalizeRuntimeEnvelopeDecoded、restoreRpcBinaryDecoded 只用于本库 codec 刚输出、未经过其它代码的对象。它们保持相同数据规则、首错与冻结元数据，但省去完整属性描述符检查，可能执行自行构造对象上的 getter。它们仍检查普通原型，structuredClone 保留的 Date/Map 不能因此被当作记录。未知来源用严格版本，不要把 Decoded 作为公开信任开关。runtime/lazy 的 scalar 分支可同步返回，stream 分支可返回 Promise，调用方应支持两种返回域。

stream 入口的 normalizeStreamPayload 校验负载；checkRpcStreamSequence/Progress/ConsumerCredit/ProducerCredit 检查连续序号、进度、消费者额度与生产者忙碌状态。合法返回 undefined，协议违规返回带 code 的 Error，由调用方选择报告、终止或取消，不把返回值当作已经自动抛错。checkRpcRuntimeStreamTransition/Intent 校验结束与提前控制是否符合起始选项。它们不调度生产者、不发送数据，也不重放已交付项。

prepareRpcBinary(envelope, storage, limit?, digest?, codec?) 生成二进制清单、sidecar 与总量；restoreRpcBinary 校验清单与完整性后还原，Decoded 版有前述信任限制。captureRpcBinaryData 同步捕获，稍后 prepare，适用于捕获时间早于编码；binary/lazy 同名操作在完整 codec 加载前捕获数据，并在需要摘要的 native 分支计算首个摘要。

native 按完整底层 ArrayBuffer 计入 backing 预算；inline 按 offset + visibleLength 计入分配预算，只复制可见字节并保留零前缀语义。limit 不无条件覆盖清单全部元数据。native + encode-only codec 的 prehash 分支另查实际整帧，inline 或其他 codec 的物理帧上限由对应 codec 或调用者负责。

digest 参数可省略；选择 native 存储时必须由调用方提供覆盖完整 backing 的真实 SHA-256，不能用占位摘要替代，inline 不需要 digest。limit 省略时默认 16 MiB，还原时 sidecars 默认空数组 []。可选末参 codec 提供元数据编码。binary/inspect 的 assertRpcNativeBinaryFrameSize 等按完整 backing 检查帧大小、读取原生二进制并分类完整性错误。这些函数不负责选择载体、传输或释放对端资源。

sections.id: 错误树-原生类型与-json-rpc-转换
sections.heading: 错误树、原生类型与 JSON-RPC 转换

blocks.text: serializeRpcError(value, options, metadata?) 的 value 和 options.report 必填；report 接收 `{ pointer, field, error }`，用于被跳过的属性读取或数据规范化失败，不能用次数统计全部截断。它按 source、code、name、message、stack，加可选 cause/errors/data/route/truncated 输出有界错误树；无身份错误使用 unknown/UNKNOWN。跨 realm 原生类型名和发送方 stack 被保留，deserializeRpcError 校验后还原 Error、RangeError、TypeError 等类型，不重新制造发送方 stack。

RpcWireErrorLimit：maxNesting 48、maxEmbeddingDepth 16、maxNodes 1024、maxStringBytes 65536、maxBytes 1048576。超预算或文本截断会裁掉内容并标 truncated；不保证每次裁剪都 report。循环边被裁去；reachRpcError(value, { report }) 遍历 cause、errors 与 cleanup 错误并按引用去重，RpcErrorReachLimit.maxObjects 为 4096。

normalizeRpcSerializedError(value, options?) 的 options 默认空对象；unknownFields 为 reject（默认）或 ignore，onUnknownField 可选、无默认 callback。deserializeRpcError(value, options?, routes?) 采用相同规则，routes 可接调用方 WeakMap 的 set 能力保存已接纳路由。序列化读取固定字段，某字段 getter 失败可报告并保留根、设置 truncated；不承诺读取错误对象的所有任意自有属性。
第三参数 metadata 的 summaries/routes 都可选，是按 Error 引用查询的 WeakMap get 能力。summaries 可给 code/message 对外摘要并隐藏内部 cause；preserveSerializedError: true 才保留该节点既有后代。routes 提供有界路由诊断，不授予控制权限。

toJsonRpcError(wire, code) 把错误树放入 error.data.migaiaWireError；整数 code 由调用方选定，不默认等于 wire code。fromJsonRpcError 也接受无扩展的普通 JSON-RPC 错误，使用 foreignSource `jsonrpc-2.0` 与整数 code 的字符串。RpcJsonRpcWireError.dataKey 维护扩展键。独立适配器使用自己的 source/code，可直接安装 utils 并用 attachErrorIdentity 保留原生错误；不要冒用官方 RPC 身份。
classifyRpcContractError(error) 只按本地对象引用识别本包签发错误，返回对外 code/message；复制或远端还原的错误返回 undefined。远端 source/code 是诊断身份，不证明本地来源，也不授予重试或控制权。

schema/wire-error 只提供结构校验起点，不等于有界 normalizer。独立实现还须执行 x-migaia-limits、canonical base64url、surrogate 等规则；Schema 的 additionalProperties 与 normalizer 默认 reject 并不等价。用其它语言实现原生对端还需长度前缀、握手和 runtime 信封；JSON-RPC 桥还需其四个扩展方法，由 rpc-process 的协议层负责，不由本包完成连接。
本包 source 为 `@migaia/rpc/contract`，常量 RPC_CONTRACT_SOURCE，code 来自 RpcContractErrorCode：

rows: 默认 Error，原生回调失败保留其类；warn/schedule/cancel 等未分类回调失败，原错或 cause 保留
TypeError；描述符身份或配置非法
TypeError；信封或 portable 业务值非法
TypeError；流字段、序号、额度或值非法
RangeError；帧语法、空负载或物理批次非法
TypeError；错误树非法，可能带 pointer/violation/cause
TypeError；握手编码、JSON 或字段非法

blocks.text: 形状失败保留对应原生类；可写回调错误原位附码且不改 stack，不可写或非 Error 值经 cause，完整外包 source/code 保留原 owner。fatal UTF-8 decoder 失败在 HANDSHAKE_INVALID/INVALID_FRAME 的 cause 中保留。

JSON-RPC 桥身份为 `@migaia/rpc/bridge/jsonrpc`（JSONRPC_BRIDGE_ERROR_SOURCE），其 JsonRpcBridgeErrorCode 包括 JSONRPC_FRAME_INVALID、JSONRPC_EXTENSION_MISSING、JSONRPC_PROFILE_INVALID、JSONRPC_UNSUPPORTED_MODE、JSONRPC_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT，分别用于分帧、缺扩展、profile、模式和握手期限。不要把桥错误当作 contract source。

其他层的 source 分别是 rpc-core 的 `@migaia/rpc/core`（RPC_CORE_ERROR_SOURCE / RpcCoreErrorCode）、rpc-core/remote 的 `@migaia/rpc/remote`（RPC_REMOTE_ERROR_SOURCE / RpcRemoteLayerErrorCode）、rpc-process 的 `@migaia/rpc/process`（RPC_PROCESS_ERROR_SOURCE / RpcProcessErrorCode）与 rpc-threads 的 `@migaia/rpc/threads`（RPC_THREAD_ERROR_SOURCE / RpcThreadErrorCode）。按 source/code 分支；message 用于展示，不用于决定重试。

简体中文
Give RPC values, messages, handshakes, fragments, and error trees a shared data boundary, so independent carriers and languages follow the same wire rules.

sections.heading: You may have run into this

items: Validated payloads still change because original references or shallow copies retain nested records and bytes.
NaN becomes null before sending because JSON conversion is mistaken for value validation.
A receiver gets only an error message because native classes, semantic codes, and cause stacks were dropped.
An error getter destroys the diagnostic because field-read failures have no separate reporting path.
Equal message identifiers mix data from different peers because assembly state has no source dimension.

Capture a payload at validation time. A shallow copy aliases nested records and bytes, while normalizePortable copies records and encodes bytes so later mutations cannot change its snapshot Runnable proof.
Reject invalid numbers instead of replacing their meaning. JSON changes NaN to null, while portable traversal checks descendants and explicitly rejects nonfinite numbers and cycles Runnable proof.

Keep the original error chain recognizable across boundaries. Sending only message drops classes and stacks, while the error tools retain semantic codes, native classes, and sender cause stacks Runnable proof.

Retain evidence for unreadable error fields. A direct property read can break logging, while serializeRpcError gives the original read failure to required report and continues its bounded tree Runnable proof.
Separate equal message identifiers by source. A map keyed only by messageId can merge peers, while the framer owns assembly state for each source/message pair Runnable proof.

blocks.text: Capture a payload, then change its caller-owned source. This performs local normalization without sending a request. Value is required; omitted depth/active starts at depth 0 with this traversal’s ancestor set.

blocks.code:
import { normalizePortable } from '@migaia/rpc-contract/portable'

const source = { profile: { name: 'Ada' }, bytes: new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3]) }
const snapshot = normalizePortable(source)
source.profile.name = 'Grace'
source.bytes[0] = 99
console.log(JSON.stringify(snapshot))
console.log(Object.isFrozen(snapshot))

blocks.text: Output:

blocks.code:
{"profile":{"name":"Ada"},"bytes":{"$rpc":"bytes","base64url":"AQID"}}
true

blocks.text: For silently changed values, see explicit value rejection. For remote errors reduced to text, see native classes and cause stacks.
Native JSON can encode values, but it does not establish this protocol’s value domain or snapshot boundary. This illustration is type-checked only and is not run:

blocks.code:
const source = { profile: { name: 'Ada' }, bytes: new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3]) }
const snapshot = { ...source } // Pitfall: shallow copying still shares profile and the byte array.
const text = JSON.stringify({ ...snapshot, total: Number.NaN }) // Pitfall: NaN becomes null instead of failing validation.
const received = JSON.parse(text) as typeof source // Pitfall: a type assertion validates neither records nor binary meaning.
void received

blocks.text: normalizePortable captures and validates under shared rules before later encoding or transport. Native JSON remains sufficient for a local document when its conversion semantics are intended.

rows: Capture values another language can represent
Transfer and inspect original error causes
A carrier delivers discrete string/binary messages
A carrier delivers arbitrary byte chunks
Validate runtime, stream control, or binary manifests

blocks.text: Portable is the value domain the protocol can represent. An envelope adds kind and route metadata around a payload. A framer defines message boundaries and assembles fragments. Source is the origin identifier supplied by a carrier. A codec converts data to an encoded value. A sidecar carries native binary beside a manifest. These tools are not a connection, authenticator, or request executor.

rows: Capture data before the caller changes it
Reject values that cannot preserve their meaning on the wire
Preserve native error classes and remote cause stacks
Report unreadable error fields without losing the wire error
Keep equal message identifiers from different peers separate
Reject out-of-order chunks and close partial assemblies

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/rpc-contract

blocks.text: Runtime dependencies are serialize and utils, without peers. The scenarios use only public entries and require no connection, server, or I/O. Directly install another module in the consuming project when importing its independent API.

rows: Capture and validate default wire business values
Preserve error chains and native classes across boundaries
Fragment and assemble discrete carrier messages
Validate runtime envelopes or stream payloads

blocks.text: This module defines RPC wire data and provides construction, validation, normalization, and framing. It opens no connection, executes no remote method, owns no Endpoint, and binds to neither Node nor DOM/Worker APIs. Stateful framers own bounded assembly buffers and expiry timers only. Runtime dependencies are `@migaia/serialize` and `@migaia/utils`, without peer dependencies.

Ordinary TypeScript callers usually use it through rpc-core, where this module is a peer dependency. Independent-language peers, carrier adapters, and cross-boundary error handling are its direct consumers. rpc-process reuses Content-Length framing and error conversion; serialize owns the underlying portable traversal and error-chain implementation.

rows: Common constants, V1 envelopes, handshake, portable values, and error tools
Wire constants/types plus pure operations such as measurePortableStreamValue
Wire-portable normalization and its depth constant
Error projection, restoration, validation, JSON-RPC mapping, and local classification
String/binary fragmentation, assembly, and physical frame inspection
Four-byte network-order length prefixes and bootstrap/handshake receivers
Content-Length byte framing and bridge error codes
Runtime envelopes, call headers, generations/steps, and lazy loading
Stream payload, sequence, progress, credit, and control-state checks
Binary capture, preparation, restoration, manifests, integrity, and size

blocks.text: These are the root and 18 subentries; the schema entry is a JSON file. Do not import internals. V1 uses named rpcProtocol and normalizeRpcEnvelope exports without a default aggregate; the root calls its protocol object rpcProtocolV1. createReassembler and IRpcReassembler were removed: use the original framer.accept/close or Pick their method types. Complete-string carriers use remoteProcessStringFramer. The bare processStringFramer is internal, without a compatibility alias.

RpcProtocol supplies the identity migaia.rpc and current major/minor 1.1. RpcCodecId maintains codec labels such as json. RpcCapability maintains versioned names such as ping@1, batch@1, stream@1, runtime-api@1, group@1, and transfer@1. Independent implementations must use the same wire values.

RpcPeerRuntime has keys such as node, bun, deno, electron, python, rust, go, and java. A valid runtime string such as browser does not imply a browser constant key exists. RpcEnvelopeKind, RpcRouteField/Key/Profile/Type, RpcWireLimit, RpcStreamLimit, and RpcWireErrorLimit own envelope, route, and budget vocabulary. Route fields include timeoutMs, idempotencyKey, and trace. RpcRuntime* defines runtime-call data. Import RpcBinaryTag from wire; binary entries expose profile/storage/native-kind domains.

createDescriptor(id, version) returns a frozen exact identity. Both arguments are required without defaults; version must be a positive safe integer. Invalid descriptors retain TypeError with INVALID_DESCRIPTOR. A descriptor does not establish a connection or register a service.

Ordinary normalizePortable(value, depth?, active?) uses the wire domain. Value is required, depth defaults to 0, and an omitted active set is created for ancestors rather than global deduplication. RPC_PORTABLE_MAX_DEPTH is 64. Repeated objects in separate branches receive separate copies; only an ancestor back-edge is a cycle.

rows: null, booleans, strings, finite numbers including -0
Frozen null-prototype copies; each enumerable own string-keyed field is read once
ArrayBuffer, Date, Map, Set, class instances, functions, symbols, bigint, undefined, nonfinite numbers, cycles

blocks.text: Undefined property values also fail. The reserved $rpc marker is accepted only for a complete valid bytes tag. Invalid alphabets, padding, or noncanonical trailing bits are not valid tags. Byte admission checks genuine internal slots, allowing other realms and legitimate Uint8Array subclasses without trusting forged toStringTag values or DataViews.

Ordinary wire traversal can execute record getters, capturing them once. This differs from strict runtime own-data validation below. Reflection/getter failures preserve their cause. The advanced native-guard overload invokes its guard without a receiver at native binary admission and preserves the thrown object; application callers rarely need to manage active or this guard.

A separate overload serves negotiated runtime native-binary data. It can retain ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array identities and uses strict own-data descriptors. This does not widen the default wire normalizer's return domain. ArrayBuffer transmission belongs to the binary profile, not ordinary portable input.

createRpcHello(offer) returns JSON text to send. acceptRpcHandshake(localOffer, hello) negotiates and returns an accepted agreement or a rejected reply/error. completeRpcHandshake(localOffer, reply) confirms the result. normalizeRpcHandshake(text) validates received handshake text. None of these functions sends data or authenticates a peer.

An offer requires peer, versions, codecs, and capabilities. peer.id/runtime describes the local participant; each version has major/minor. Codecs must include json and preserve preference order. Capabilities are unique versioned names; an empty list proposes no optional capabilities. Optional auth carries portable credentials for upper-layer validation, not proof that authentication succeeded. Agreement.peer always describes the other side.

Negotiation selects the highest shared major, the lower shared minor, the first common codec in initiator order, and the capability intersection in initiator order. An incompatible version or codec yields ok false and a reject reply from the responder. The initiator receives HANDSHAKE_REJECTED, potentially with HANDSHAKE_INCOMPATIBLE on cause. Invalid UTF-8, JSON, fields, or selections produce HANDSHAKE_INVALID rather than an automatic downgrade.

Public handshake causes may be bounded frozen redaction summaries. Credential-bearing raw text, objects, and engine JSON excerpts are not unconditionally retained. A verified clean native decoder/getter failure can still retain its exact identity. Classify by source/code rather than depending on raw input echoes.
The native prefix and JSON-RPC Content-Length formats are different and cannot be mixed.

rows: encodeRpcStreamFrame; createRpcStreamFrameDecoder delivers onFrame and reports its first protocol failure through onError before termination
encodeJsonRpcFrame; createJsonRpcFrameDecoder.push returns complete values, while invalid push/finish operations throw bridge errors

blocks.text: The native encoder requires a nonempty Uint8Array payload. RPC_STREAM_MAX_FRAME_BYTES is 16 MiB. Empty or invalid payloads produce INVALID_FRAME; oversize produces FRAME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED. Decoder options require both onFrame(frame) and onError(error), without defaults. push accepts arbitrary splits and copies input into its owned frame storage, allowing the caller to reuse chunks. finish checks partial EOF and terminates this decoder; close discards state. Calling close/finish from onFrame stops remaining delivery from the current chunk.

createRpcStreamFrameDecoderWithLimit(options, maxFrameBytes) reads the current limit before each allocation, supporting smaller handshake budgets. Both callbacks and the limit function are caller-supplied. Bootstrap and handshake receivers process the first frame and queue later data before activation, without owning a connection.

Content-Length uses actual UTF-8 byte length rather than JavaScript string length. Its decoder has no constructor arguments; push may return no messages or several, and bufferedBytes reports retained bytes. JsonRpcLimit has headerBytes 1024, bodyBytes 16 MiB, and handshakeMs 10000. Malformed/duplicate/missing headers, invalid UTF-8/JSON, or partial EOF produce JSONRPC_FRAME_INVALID. Here finish only checks leftovers and does not close the decoder. close clears it and makes later push calls return an empty array. Do not apply native-prefix onError/termination semantics to this decoder.

createStringFramer(options?) and createBinaryFramer(options?) provide a descriptor, encoded-type labels, frame(value, context), accept(frame, context), and close(reason?). Context requires source and messageId. The carrier supplies source to separate equal message identifiers from different origins. frame returns physical frames. accept returns pending, complete/value, or rejected/error; categorized rejection results are not all thrown exceptions.
Options default to an empty object. Numeric fields must be positive safe integers.

chunkBytes cannot exceed maxMessageBytes, which cannot exceed maxBufferedBytes. Callers can supply schedule(callback, delayMs) and cancel(handle); otherwise available host setTimeout/clearTimeout are used. The module does not invent timer support when the host lacks it.

The now field is retained but does not drive assembly expiry; changing a fake now alone does not advance the timer. The framer owns its timers and should be closed by its owner. Complete messages and fragments both enforce maxMessageBytes. String limits use UTF-16 code units despite byte-oriented option names; binary limits use byteLength. Inspect encoded physical UTF-8 size separately with inspectRpcPhysicalFrame(value, limit).

Fragments must satisfy first-chunk, order, count, and total-length rules. Late, duplicate, expired, or oversized input is rejected. Assemblies use the source/messageId pair rather than ambiguous delimiter concatenation. The caller handles result dispatch; the framer sends no network data and does not authenticate source.

Timers are detached before cancellation, so reentrant close does not cancel twice. Unclassified schedule/warn failures receive CALLBACK_FAILED. Cancel failures reach available host reportError or utils' host exception queue, preserving the cleanup primary and reporter secondary without replacing a completed frame result. Physical inspection measures actual encoded frames; splitBatch divides splittable batches in half, while an oversized single message fails with RangeError.
remoteProcessStringFramer preserves existing complete-string carrier boundaries without fragmentation. Nonstring input retains TypeError with INVALID_FRAME.

normalizeRuntimeEnvelope validates live received runtime records through own data properties, rejecting accessors without invoking them. Runtime request/notify/stream/group vocabulary belongs to runtime. createRuntimeCallEnvelope in runtime/metadata constructs outbound call headers; normalizeRuntimeGeneration and normalizeRuntimeSteps validate generations and group steps. Steps must form a nonempty dense own-data array; there is no separate fixed step-count limit, and physical byte budgets remain independent.

normalizeRuntimeEnvelopeDecoded and restoreRpcBinaryDecoded are for fresh output of this module's codec that no other code has touched. They preserve data grammar, first-error behavior, and frozen metadata while omitting full descriptor checks, so hand-built getters can execute. Ordinary prototype checks still apply: structuredClone preserving Date/Map does not make them records. Use strict variants for uncertain input. Decoded is not a public trust flag. In runtime/lazy, scalar paths may return synchronously and stream paths may return a Promise; callers support both.

normalizeStreamPayload validates payloads. checkRpcStreamSequence/Progress/ConsumerCredit/ProducerCredit check consecutive sequence, progress, consumer credit, and producer busy state. blocks.text: Each independent example matches its website case and opens no connection. Install the module first:

blocks.code: pnpm add @migaia/rpc-contract

sections.heading: Capture data before the caller changes it

blocks.text: An adapter validates a payload, then the caller changes its nested object or byte array before encoding. The message should keep the values admitted at the validation boundary.
Keeping the original object lets later mutations change what is sent. A shallow spread still shares nested records and bytes, so it does not establish a stable payload snapshot.
normalizePortable creates a frozen portable snapshot. The default wire profile copies records and converts Uint8Array bytes into a canonical unpadded Base64URL tag; it does not send a request.

normalizePortable requires value. Here profile/name and bytes are business data rather than RPC endpoint fields. Omitting depth/active starts at depth 0 with this traversal’s ancestor set. The Uint8Array’s visible bytes become an unpadded base64url tag instead of retaining the original array identity.

blocks.code:
import { normalizePortable } from '@migaia/rpc-contract/portable'

const source = { profile: { name: 'Ada' }, bytes: new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3]) }
const snapshot = normalizePortable(source)
source.profile.name = 'Grace'
source.bytes[0] = 99
console.log(JSON.stringify(snapshot))
console.log(Object.isFrozen(snapshot))

blocks.text: Output:

blocks.code:
{"profile":{"name":"Ada"},"bytes":{"$rpc":"bytes","base64url":"AQID"}}
true

blocks.text: Prints `{"profile":{"name":"Ada"},"bytes":{"$rpc":"bytes","base64url":"AQID"}}` and `true`. Later source mutations do not change the captured name or the encoded bytes.

Ordinary records become frozen null-prototype snapshots. This default profile produces a bytes tag, not a restored Uint8Array; negotiated native-binary paths have a separate contract. Getters on ordinary wire records are read once and can execute user code.

sections.heading: Reject values that cannot preserve their meaning on the wire

blocks.text: A nonfinite measurement can be silently saved as null, while a cyclic payload cannot form a finite wire tree. Both should be rejected before an adapter commits to sending the message.
JSON.stringify changes NaN to null inside a record. Checking only the top-level object misses invalid descendants and cycles that appear deeper in the payload.

normalizePortable walks the supported value tree and rejects invalid descendants. Compare the JSON result with the categorized TypeError, then submit a separate cyclic object through the same public entry.

Both calls require value: a record containing NaN, then a self-reference. No advanced options are passed. The default domain accepts only finite numbers, with root depth 0 and maximum depth 64. Invalid data throws TypeError with INVALID_ENVELOPE.
Output:
Prints `{"total":null}`, `nonfinite: true INVALID_ENVELOPE`, then `cycle: true INVALID_ENVELOPE`. Validation neither substitutes a finite value nor accepts a recursive reference.

The default domain includes null, booleans, finite numbers, strings, arrays, plain records and portable bytes. Its maximum depth is 64 with root depth 0; Date, Map, Set, functions and unsupported primitive values are not admitted.

sections.heading: Preserve native error classes and remote cause stacks

blocks.text: A remote operation fails with a TypeError caused by a RangeError. The receiver needs both semantic codes and the original stacks to understand which operation failed and why.
Sending only error.message drops the cause tree, native classes and stacks. Creating a fresh local error from that text assigns a receiving-side stack that hides the original failure location.

serializeRpcError projects a bounded coded tree, and deserializeRpcError validates it before restoring native classes. Supply the required report callback to retain any fields that cannot be read or normalized.

serializeRpcError requires value and options. options.report is a required synchronous callback; here it collects failure records without an implicit reporter. source/code supplies semantic identity and cause carries the original reason. deserializeRpcError options may be omitted; unknown fields default to reject.
Output:

blocks.code:
true true
true true
REQUEST LIMIT 0

blocks.text: Prints `true true`, `true true`, then `REQUEST LIMIT 0`. Both native classes and stack strings survive the round trip, both semantic codes remain present, and no field failures are reported.

Restoration creates new Error objects, so cross-boundary object identity is not preserved. The tree is bounded and can carry cause, AggregateError errors and a truncation marker; no connection or request is executed by these functions.

sections.heading: Report unreadable error fields without losing the wire error

blocks.text: A diagnostic serializer encounters an Error whose message getter throws. Losing the whole diagnostic would hide both the original operation and the new field-read failure.
Direct property reads while building a JSON object let the getter exception escape the logging path. Ignoring that exception instead removes evidence that a field was omitted.

serializeRpcError captures supported fields and routes omitted read failures to report. Save the fixture stack before installing its hostile message getter, then collect each report record for inspection.

Each report entry contains pointer, field, and error. The error here is the original message-getter failure. No metadata argument supplies custom summaries or routes. Object.defineProperty builds a local failure fixture rather than configuring the normalizer.
Output:

blocks.code:
Error UNKNOWN
1 message true

blocks.text: Prints `Error UNKNOWN` and `1 message true`. A wire error is still returned, and the report identifies the unreadable message field with the exact original TypeError.

report is required and receives pointer, field and the original failure synchronously. These records are local diagnostic evidence, not extra wire fields. Untagged errors use the unknown source/code fallback; unreadable fields follow the bounded serializer policy.

sections.heading: Keep equal message identifiers from different peers separate

blocks.text: Two peers each send a fragmented message named job. Their chunks can interleave, but completing one message must not concatenate bytes from the other peer.
A buffer map keyed only by messageId merges unrelated senders. Even ordered chunks then produce a plausible but incorrect combined value, or consume another sender assembly state.
createStringFramer retains assemblies by source and messageId together. Set chunkBytes to 2, interleave the two first fragments, then finish each source separately and close the framer.

Options are optional and default to empty. Here chunkBytes changes from 16384 to 2; string units are UTF-16 code units. context.source and context.messageId are required without defaults. Both origins reuse job. frame/accept require a value and context; close has an optional reason.
Output:

blocks.code:
pending pending
abcd
wxyz

blocks.text: Prints `pending pending`, `abcd`, then `wxyz`. Both partial assemblies coexist despite sharing job as messageId, and each complete result contains only its own source data.

The caller owns trusted source attribution and message correlation; frame data does not authenticate a peer. This string profile counts UTF-16 code units despite the chunkBytes option name, requires ordered delivery, and releases retained timers through close().

sections.heading: Reject out-of-order chunks and close partial assemblies

blocks.text: A receiver sees the second fragment before the first, then shuts down after receiving only a prefix. It needs an explicit rejection result and a way to release the unfinished assembly.
Joining whichever fragments arrive produces reordered payloads. Keeping the prefix after shutdown leaves assembly buffers and timeout ownership alive beyond the receiver lifetime.

createStringFramer.accept returns pending, complete or rejected. Submit the out-of-order fragment, start a valid prefix, then call close() before another accept to observe the terminal ingress boundary.

The example uses chunkBytes: 2 and required source/messageId. accept returns pending, complete/value, or rejected/error without reordering fragments. close(reason?) defaults reason to undefined, releases retained state, and rejects further ingress. Other limits retain the defaults below.
Output:

blocks.code:
rejected INVALID_FRAME
pending
rejected INVALID_FRAME

blocks.text: Prints `rejected INVALID_FRAME`, `pending`, then `rejected INVALID_FRAME`. The early second fragment is refused; after a valid prefix, close() prevents further acceptance.

Invalid incoming fragments return categorized rejections, while invalid construction limits throw. close() clears assemblies and timers; this framer does not reorder or retry delivery, and frame-size, chunk-count and concurrency limits still apply.

This module defines RPC wire data and provides construction, validation, normalization, and framing. It opens no connection, executes no remote method, owns no Endpoint, and binds to neither Node nor DOM/Worker APIs. Stateful framers own bounded assembly buffers and expiry timers only. Runtime dependencies are `@migaia/serialize` and `@migaia/utils`, without peer dependencies.

Ordinary TypeScript callers usually use it through rpc-core, where this module is a peer dependency. Independent-language peers, carrier adapters, and cross-boundary error handling are its direct consumers. rpc-process reuses Content-Length framing and error conversion; serialize owns the underlying portable traversal and error-chain implementation.

blocks.text: These are the root and 18 subentries; the schema entry is a JSON file. Do not import internals. V1 uses named rpcProtocol and normalizeRpcEnvelope exports without a default aggregate; the root calls its protocol object rpcProtocolV1. createReassembler and IRpcReassembler were removed: use the original framer.accept/close or Pick their method types. Complete-string carriers use remoteProcessStringFramer. The bare processStringFramer is internal, without a compatibility alias.

RpcProtocol supplies the identity migaia.rpc and current major/minor 1.1. RpcCodecId maintains codec labels such as json. RpcCapability maintains versioned names such as ping@1, batch@1, stream@1, runtime-api@1, group@1, and transfer@1. Independent implementations must use the same wire values.

RpcPeerRuntime has keys such as node, bun, deno, electron, python, rust, go, and java. A valid runtime string such as browser does not imply a browser constant key exists. RpcEnvelopeKind, RpcRouteField/Key/Profile/Type, RpcWireLimit, RpcStreamLimit, and RpcWireErrorLimit own envelope, route, and budget vocabulary. Route fields include timeoutMs, idempotencyKey, and trace. RpcRuntime* defines runtime-call data. Import RpcBinaryTag from wire; binary entries expose profile/storage/native-kind domains.

createDescriptor(id, version) returns a frozen exact identity. Both arguments are required without defaults; version must be a positive safe integer. Invalid descriptors retain TypeError with INVALID_DESCRIPTOR. A descriptor does not establish a connection or register a service.

Ordinary normalizePortable(value, depth?, active?) uses the wire domain. Value is required, depth defaults to 0, and an omitted active set is created for ancestors rather than global deduplication. RPC_PORTABLE_MAX_DEPTH is 64. Repeated objects in separate branches receive separate copies; only an ancestor back-edge is a cycle.

rows: null, booleans, strings, finite numbers including -0
Frozen null-prototype copies; each enumerable own string-keyed field is read once
ArrayBuffer, Date, Map, Set, class instances, functions, symbols, bigint, undefined, nonfinite numbers, cycles

blocks.text: Undefined property values also fail. The reserved $rpc marker is accepted only for a complete valid bytes tag. Invalid alphabets, padding, or noncanonical trailing bits are not valid tags. Byte admission checks genuine internal slots, allowing other realms and legitimate Uint8Array subclasses without trusting forged toStringTag values or DataViews.

Ordinary wire traversal can execute record getters, capturing them once. This differs from strict runtime own-data validation below. Reflection/getter failures preserve their cause. The advanced native-guard overload invokes its guard without a receiver at native binary admission and preserves the thrown object; application callers rarely need to manage active or this guard.

A separate overload serves negotiated runtime native-binary data. It can retain ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array identities and uses strict own-data descriptors. This does not widen the default wire normalizer's return domain. ArrayBuffer transmission belongs to the binary profile, not ordinary portable input.

createRpcHello(offer) returns JSON text to send. acceptRpcHandshake(localOffer, hello) negotiates and returns an accepted agreement or a rejected reply/error. completeRpcHandshake(localOffer, reply) confirms the result. normalizeRpcHandshake(text) validates received handshake text. None of these functions sends data or authenticates a peer.

An offer requires peer, versions, codecs, and capabilities. peer.id/runtime describes the local participant; each version has major/minor. Codecs must include json and preserve preference order. Capabilities are unique versioned names; an empty list proposes no optional capabilities. Optional auth carries portable credentials for upper-layer validation, not proof that authentication succeeded. Agreement.peer always describes the other side.

Negotiation selects the highest shared major, the lower shared minor, the first common codec in initiator order, and the capability intersection in initiator order. An incompatible version or codec yields ok false and a reject reply from the responder. The initiator receives HANDSHAKE_REJECTED, potentially with HANDSHAKE_INCOMPATIBLE on cause. Invalid UTF-8, JSON, fields, or selections produce HANDSHAKE_INVALID rather than an automatic downgrade.

Public handshake causes may be bounded frozen redaction summaries. Credential-bearing raw text, objects, and engine JSON excerpts are not unconditionally retained. A verified clean native decoder/getter failure can still retain its exact identity. Classify by source/code rather than depending on raw input echoes.
The native prefix and JSON-RPC Content-Length formats are different and cannot be mixed.

rows: encodeRpcStreamFrame; createRpcStreamFrameDecoder delivers onFrame and reports its first protocol failure through onError before termination
encodeJsonRpcFrame; createJsonRpcFrameDecoder.push returns complete values, while invalid push/finish operations throw bridge errors

blocks.text: The native encoder requires a nonempty Uint8Array payload. RPC_STREAM_MAX_FRAME_BYTES is 16 MiB. Empty or invalid payloads produce INVALID_FRAME; oversize produces FRAME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED. Decoder options require both onFrame(frame) and onError(error), without defaults. push accepts arbitrary splits and copies input into its owned frame storage, allowing the caller to reuse chunks. finish checks partial EOF and terminates this decoder; close discards state. Calling close/finish from onFrame stops remaining delivery from the current chunk.

createRpcStreamFrameDecoderWithLimit(options, maxFrameBytes) reads the current limit before each allocation, supporting smaller handshake budgets. Both callbacks and the limit function are caller-supplied. Bootstrap and handshake receivers process the first frame and queue later data before activation, without owning a connection.

Content-Length uses actual UTF-8 byte length rather than JavaScript string length. Its decoder has no constructor arguments; push may return no messages or several, and bufferedBytes reports retained bytes. JsonRpcLimit has headerBytes 1024, bodyBytes 16 MiB, and handshakeMs 10000. Malformed/duplicate/missing headers, invalid UTF-8/JSON, or partial EOF produce JSONRPC_FRAME_INVALID. Here finish only checks leftovers and does not close the decoder. close clears it and makes later push calls return an empty array. Do not apply native-prefix onError/termination semantics to this decoder.

createStringFramer(options?) and createBinaryFramer(options?) provide a descriptor, encoded-type labels, frame(value, context), accept(frame, context), and close(reason?). Context requires source and messageId. The carrier supplies source to separate equal message identifiers from different origins. frame returns physical frames. accept returns pending, complete/value, or rejected/error; categorized rejection results are not all thrown exceptions.
Options default to an empty object. Numeric fields must be positive safe integers.

chunkBytes cannot exceed maxMessageBytes, which cannot exceed maxBufferedBytes. Callers can supply schedule(callback, delayMs) and cancel(handle); otherwise available host setTimeout/clearTimeout are used. The module does not invent timer support when the host lacks it.

The now field is retained but does not drive assembly expiry; changing a fake now alone does not advance the timer. The framer owns its timers and should be closed by its owner. Complete messages and fragments both enforce maxMessageBytes. String limits use UTF-16 code units despite byte-oriented option names; binary limits use byteLength. Inspect encoded physical UTF-8 size separately with inspectRpcPhysicalFrame(value, limit).

Fragments must satisfy first-chunk, order, count, and total-length rules. Late, duplicate, expired, or oversized input is rejected. Assemblies use the source/messageId pair rather than ambiguous delimiter concatenation. The caller handles result dispatch; the framer sends no network data and does not authenticate source.

Timers are detached before cancellation, so reentrant close does not cancel twice. Unclassified schedule/warn failures receive CALLBACK_FAILED. Cancel failures reach available host reportError or utils' host exception queue, preserving the cleanup primary and reporter secondary without replacing a completed frame result. Physical inspection measures actual encoded frames; splitBatch divides splittable batches in half, while an oversized single message fails with RangeError.
remoteProcessStringFramer preserves existing complete-string carrier boundaries without fragmentation. Nonstring input retains TypeError with INVALID_FRAME.

Steps must form a nonempty dense own-data array; there is no separate fixed step-count limit, and physical byte budgets remain independent.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Frozen canonical protocol descriptor combines stable message/version identity with normalizeRpcEnvelope; it owns validation but no connection or execution.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import rpcProtocolV1 from @migaia/rpc-contract, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use rpcProtocolV1 when its const contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when rpcProtocolV1 does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained const example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
id: Application or protocol-owner correlation identifier; preserve it on replies and controls for the same task.
version: Positive component format version chosen by the component owner, independent of package versions.
normalize: Snapshots and validates one unknown decoded semantic envelope at the selected protocol boundary.
normalize.value: Unknown value produced by the actual codec or application input.
normalize.options: Optional IRpcEnvelopeOptions for observing unknown additive fields.
Validated protocol envelope; original native validation errors propagate.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content: Implement an independent compatible peer using the original protocol-owned data shape.

symbols.signature: export declare function captureRpcBinaryData(message: IRpcRuntimeEnvelope, storage: RpcBinaryStorage, limit?: number, digest?: IRpcBinaryDigest, codec?: IRpcBinaryDataCodec): IRpcCapturedBinaryData;
symbols.purpose: Synchronously captures the original protocol graph and backing references at the caller-selected snapshot point. Pair with restoreRpcBinary for a complete inline round trip; preparation can finish later.
symbols.core:
message: Normalized IRpcRuntimeEnvelope from the canonical runtime constructor or strict normalizer, containing actual business binary roots.
storage: Application-selected inline or native RpcBinaryStorage matching the negotiated carrier capability.
limit: Optional binary allocation budget, default `16777216` bytes: native storage charges the full backing; inline storage charges offset plus visible bytes. Codec/prehash and the outer carrier own any complete physical-frame limit.
digest: Optional IRpcBinaryDigest; native mode requires it. The asynchronous callback receives each complete original ArrayBuffer and resolves SHA-256 text; rejection fails preparation.
codec: Optional application-held IRpcBinaryDataCodec owns representation encoding and optional inline capture; its throws fail the original preparation; the native prehash path checks encoded physical size, while other representations retain their codec or outer-carrier limit responsibility.
IRpcCapturedBinaryData; malformed graph, backing or budget throws INVALID_ENVELOPE synchronously.

storage: RpcBinaryStorage
limit: number (optional)
digest: IRpcBinaryDigest (optional)
codec: IRpcBinaryDataCodec (optional)

symbols.purpose: Captures one canonical runtime envelope before yielding, then finishes manifest encoding and complete-backing digests. Pair with restoreRpcBinary; no endpoint, replay or execution state is changed. This entry loads the canonical parser lazily without changing synchronous capture or digest ownership.
symbols.core:
message: Normalized IRpcRuntimeEnvelope from the canonical runtime constructor or strict normalizer, containing actual business binary roots.
storage: Application-selected inline or native RpcBinaryStorage matching the negotiated carrier capability.
limit: Optional binary allocation budget, default `16777216` bytes: native storage charges the full backing; inline storage charges offset plus visible bytes. Codec/prehash and the outer carrier own any complete physical-frame limit.
digest: Optional IRpcBinaryDigest; native mode requires it. The asynchronous callback receives each complete original ArrayBuffer and resolves SHA-256 text; rejection fails preparation.
codec: Optional application-held IRpcBinaryDataCodec owns representation encoding and optional inline capture; its throws fail the original preparation; the native prehash path checks encoded physical size, while other representations retain their codec or outer-carrier limit responsibility.
Promise of IRpcPreparedBinary; failures reject with native coded INVALID_ENVELOPE and retained cause.

storage: RpcBinaryStorage
limit: number (optional)
digest: IRpcBinaryDigest (optional)
codec: IRpcBinaryDataCodec (optional)

guidance.heading: 错误树、原生类型与 JSON-RPC 转换

blocks.text: serializeRpcError(value, options, metadata?) 的 value 和 options.report 必填；report 接收 `{ pointer, field, error }`，用于被跳过的属性读取或数据规范化失败，不能用次数统计全部截断。它按 source、code、name、message、stack，加可选 cause/errors/data/route/truncated 输出有界错误树；无身份错误使用 unknown/UNKNOWN。跨 realm 原生类型名和发送方 stack 被保留，deserializeRpcError 校验后还原 Error、RangeError、TypeError 等类型，不重新制造发送方 stack。

RpcWireErrorLimit：maxNesting 48、maxEmbeddingDepth 16、maxNodes 1024、maxStringBytes 65536、maxBytes 1048576。超预算或文本截断会裁掉内容并标 truncated；不保证每次裁剪都 report。循环边被裁去；reachRpcError(value, { report }) 遍历 cause、errors 与 cleanup 错误并按引用去重，RpcErrorReachLimit.maxObjects 为 4096。

normalizeRpcSerializedError(value, options?) 的 options 默认空对象；unknownFields 为 reject（默认）或 ignore，onUnknownField 可选、无默认 callback。deserializeRpcError(value, options?, routes?) 采用相同规则，routes 可接调用方 WeakMap 的 set 能力保存已接纳路由。序列化读取固定字段，某字段 getter 失败可报告并保留根、设置 truncated；不承诺读取错误对象的所有任意自有属性。
第三参数 metadata 的 summaries/routes 都可选，是按 Error 引用查询的 WeakMap get 能力。summaries 可给 code/message 对外摘要并隐藏内部 cause；preserveSerializedError: true 才保留该节点既有后代。routes 提供有界路由诊断，不授予控制权限。

toJsonRpcError(wire, code) 把错误树放入 error.data.migaiaWireError；整数 code 由调用方选定，不默认等于 wire code。fromJsonRpcError 也接受无扩展的普通 JSON-RPC 错误，使用 foreignSource `jsonrpc-2.0` 与整数 code 的字符串。RpcJsonRpcWireError.dataKey 维护扩展键。独立适配器使用自己的 source/code，可直接安装 utils 并用 attachErrorIdentity 保留原生错误；不要冒用官方 RPC 身份。
classifyRpcContractError(error) 只按本地对象引用识别本包签发错误，返回对外 code/message；复制或远端还原的错误返回 undefined。远端 source/code 是诊断身份，不证明本地来源，也不授予重试或控制权。

schema/wire-error 只提供结构校验起点，不等于有界 normalizer。独立实现还须执行 x-migaia-limits、canonical base64url、surrogate 等规则；Schema 的 additionalProperties 与 normalizer 默认 reject 并不等价。用其它语言实现原生对端还需长度前缀、握手和 runtime 信封；JSON-RPC 桥还需其四个扩展方法，由 rpc-process 的协议层负责，不由本包完成连接。

guidance.id: 保留原生错误类型与远端原因堆栈
guidance.heading: 保留原生错误类型与远端原因堆栈

blocks.text: 远端操作因范围错误而抛出类型错误，接收方需要两层语义码和原始堆栈，才能辨认失败操作及根因。
只发送错误消息会丢掉原因树、原生类型与堆栈，用该文字在本地重建错误，又会生成接收端堆栈并掩盖原始失败位置。
`serializeRpcError` 投影有界带码树，`deserializeRpcError` 校验后恢复原生类型，须提供 `report` 回调以保留无法读取或规范化字段的失败。
`serializeRpcError(value, options)` 两项必填；options.report 是必填同步回调，本例把每个失败记录放入 reports，没有额外默认报告器。source/code 是错误的语义身份，cause 是原始原因。deserializeRpcError 的 options 可省略，未知字段默认 reject。
输出：

blocks.code:
true true
true true
REQUEST LIMIT 0

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `true true`、`true true`、`REQUEST LIMIT 0`，往返保留两种原生类型、两份堆栈字符串和语义码，未报告字段失败。
恢复会创建新的错误对象，不保留跨边界对象身份；错误树有界，可携带 `cause`、聚合错误子项和截断标记，这些函数不建立连接或执行请求。

normalizeRpcSerializedError(value, options?) 的 options 默认空对象；unknownFields 为 reject（默认）或 ignore，onUnknownField 可选、无默认 callback。deserializeRpcError(value, options?, routes?) 采用相同规则，routes 可接调用方 WeakMap 的 set 能力保存已接纳路由。序列化读取固定字段，某字段 getter 失败可报告并保留根、设置 truncated；不承诺读取错误对象的所有任意自有属性。
第三参数 metadata 的 summaries/routes 都可选，是按 Error 引用查询的 WeakMap get 能力。summaries 可给 code/message 对外摘要并隐藏内部 cause；preserveSerializedError: true 才保留该节点既有后代。routes 提供有界路由诊断，不授予控制权限。

toJsonRpcError(wire, code) 把错误树放入 error.data.migaiaWireError；整数 code 由调用方选定，不默认等于 wire code。fromJsonRpcError 也接受无扩展的普通 JSON-RPC 错误，使用 foreignSource `jsonrpc-2.0` 与整数 code 的字符串。RpcJsonRpcWireError.dataKey 维护扩展键。独立适配器使用自己的 source/code，可直接安装 utils 并用 attachErrorIdentity 保留原生错误；不要冒用官方 RPC 身份。
classifyRpcContractError(error) 只按本地对象引用识别本包签发错误，返回对外 code/message；复制或远端还原的错误返回 undefined。远端 source/code 是诊断身份，不证明本地来源，也不授予重试或控制权。

schema/wire-error 只提供结构校验起点，不等于有界 normalizer。独立实现还须执行 x-migaia-limits、canonical base64url、surrogate 等规则；Schema 的 additionalProperties 与 normalizer 默认 reject 并不等价。用其它语言实现原生对端还需长度前缀、握手和 runtime 信封；JSON-RPC 桥还需其四个扩展方法，由 rpc-process 的协议层负责，不由本包完成连接。

guidance.id: 报告不可读字段并继续生成线上错误
guidance.heading: 报告不可读字段并继续生成线上错误

blocks.text: 诊断序列化遇到消息访问器会抛错的错误对象，丢弃整条诊断会同时掩盖原操作与新的字段读取失败。
构建 JSON 对象时直接读取属性，会让访问器异常逃出日志路径，若忽略该异常，又会丢失字段被省略的依据。
`serializeRpcError` 捕获支持字段，并把被省略的读取失败交给 `report`；本例先保存错误堆栈，再设置会抛错的消息访问器，收集报告记录供检查。
options.report 的 entry 包含 pointer、field、error；本例 error 是 message getter 的原始失败。第三参数 metadata 未提供，不启用调用方摘要或路由表。Object.defineProperty 是构造本地失败样本，不是 normalizer 的配置项。
输出：

blocks.code:
Error UNKNOWN
1 message true

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `Error UNKNOWN`、`1 message true`，仍返回线上错误，报告指出不可读的消息字段并保留原始 `TypeError`。
`report` 必填，同步收到指针、字段和原始失败；这些记录是本地诊断依据，不是额外线上字段，未编码错误使用未知来源与错误码兜底，不可读字段遵守有界序列化策略。

blocks.text: serializeRpcError(value, options, metadata?) 的 value 和 options.report 必填；report 接收 `{ pointer, field, error }`，用于被跳过的属性读取或数据规范化失败，不能用次数统计全部截断。它按 source、code、name、message、stack，加可选 cause/errors/data/route/truncated 输出有界错误树；无身份错误使用 unknown/UNKNOWN。跨 realm 原生类型名和发送方 stack 被保留，deserializeRpcError 校验后还原 Error、RangeError、TypeError 等类型，不重新制造发送方 stack。

RpcWireErrorLimit：maxNesting 48、maxEmbeddingDepth 16、maxNodes 1024、maxStringBytes 65536、maxBytes 1048576。超预算或文本截断会裁掉内容并标 truncated；不保证每次裁剪都 report。循环边被裁去；reachRpcError(value, { report }) 遍历 cause、errors 与 cleanup 错误并按引用去重，RpcErrorReachLimit.maxObjects 为 4096。

normalizeRpcSerializedError(value, options?) 的 options 默认空对象；unknownFields 为 reject（默认）或 ignore，onUnknownField 可选、无默认 callback。deserializeRpcError(value, options?, routes?) 采用相同规则，routes 可接调用方 WeakMap 的 set 能力保存已接纳路由。序列化读取固定字段，某字段 getter 失败可报告并保留根、设置 truncated；不承诺读取错误对象的所有任意自有属性。
第三参数 metadata 的 summaries/routes 都可选，是按 Error 引用查询的 WeakMap get 能力。summaries 可给 code/message 对外摘要并隐藏内部 cause；preserveSerializedError: true 才保留该节点既有后代。routes 提供有界路由诊断，不授予控制权限。

toJsonRpcError(wire, code) 把错误树放入 error.data.migaiaWireError；整数 code 由调用方选定，不默认等于 wire code。fromJsonRpcError 也接受无扩展的普通 JSON-RPC 错误，使用 foreignSource `jsonrpc-2.0` 与整数 code 的字符串。RpcJsonRpcWireError.dataKey 维护扩展键。独立适配器使用自己的 source/code，可直接安装 utils 并用 attachErrorIdentity 保留原生错误；不要冒用官方 RPC 身份。
classifyRpcContractError(error) 只按本地对象引用识别本包签发错误，返回对外 code/message；复制或远端还原的错误返回 undefined。远端 source/code 是诊断身份，不证明本地来源，也不授予重试或控制权。

schema/wire-error 只提供结构校验起点，不等于有界 normalizer。独立实现还须执行 x-migaia-limits、canonical base64url、surrogate 等规则；Schema 的 additionalProperties 与 normalizer 默认 reject 并不等价。用其它语言实现原生对端还需长度前缀、握手和 runtime 信封；JSON-RPC 桥还需其四个扩展方法，由 rpc-process 的协议层负责，不由本包完成连接。

blocks.text: 本包 source 为 `@migaia/rpc/contract`，常量 RPC_CONTRACT_SOURCE，code 来自 RpcContractErrorCode：

rows: 默认 Error，原生回调失败保留其类；warn/schedule/cancel 等未分类回调失败，原错或 cause 保留
TypeError；描述符身份或配置非法
TypeError；信封或 portable 业务值非法
TypeError；流字段、序号、额度或值非法
RangeError；帧语法、空负载或物理批次非法
TypeError；错误树非法，可能带 pointer/violation/cause
TypeError；握手编码、JSON 或字段非法
Error；版本、codec 或所需能力不兼容
Error；对端拒绝，检查受控 cause

blocks.text: 形状失败保留对应原生类；可写回调错误原位附码且不改 stack，不可写或非 Error 值经 cause，完整外包 source/code 保留原 owner。fatal UTF-8 decoder 失败在 HANDSHAKE_INVALID/INVALID_FRAME 的 cause 中保留。

JSON-RPC 桥身份为 `@migaia/rpc/bridge/jsonrpc`（JSONRPC_BRIDGE_ERROR_SOURCE），其 JsonRpcBridgeErrorCode 包括 JSONRPC_FRAME_INVALID、JSONRPC_EXTENSION_MISSING、JSONRPC_PROFILE_INVALID、JSONRPC_UNSUPPORTED_MODE、JSONRPC_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT，分别用于分帧、缺扩展、profile、模式和握手期限。不要把桥错误当作 contract source。

其他层的 source 分别是 rpc-core 的 `@migaia/rpc/core`（RPC_CORE_ERROR_SOURCE / RpcCoreErrorCode）、rpc-core/remote 的 `@migaia/rpc/remote`（RPC_REMOTE_ERROR_SOURCE / RpcRemoteLayerErrorCode）、rpc-process 的 `@migaia/rpc/process`（RPC_PROCESS_ERROR_SOURCE / RpcProcessErrorCode）与 rpc-threads 的 `@migaia/rpc/threads`（RPC_THREAD_ERROR_SOURCE / RpcThreadErrorCode）。按 source/code 分支；message 用于展示，不用于决定重试。

guidance.heading: 错误树、原生类型与 JSON-RPC 转换

blocks.text: serializeRpcError(value, options, metadata?) 的 value 和 options.report 必填；report 接收 `{ pointer, field, error }`，用于被跳过的属性读取或数据规范化失败，不能用次数统计全部截断。它按 source、code、name、message、stack，加可选 cause/errors/data/route/truncated 输出有界错误树；无身份错误使用 unknown/UNKNOWN。跨 realm 原生类型名和发送方 stack 被保留，deserializeRpcError 校验后还原 Error、RangeError、TypeError 等类型，不重新制造发送方 stack。

RpcWireErrorLimit：maxNesting 48、maxEmbeddingDepth 16、maxNodes 1024、maxStringBytes 65536、maxBytes 1048576。超预算或文本截断会裁掉内容并标 truncated；不保证每次裁剪都 report。循环边被裁去；reachRpcError(value, { report }) 遍历 cause、errors 与 cleanup 错误并按引用去重，RpcErrorReachLimit.maxObjects 为 4096。

normalizeRpcSerializedError(value, options?) 的 options 默认空对象；unknownFields 为 reject（默认）或 ignore，onUnknownField 可选、无默认 callback。deserializeRpcError(value, options?, routes?) 采用相同规则，routes 可接调用方 WeakMap 的 set 能力保存已接纳路由。序列化读取固定字段，某字段 getter 失败可报告并保留根、设置 truncated；不承诺读取错误对象的所有任意自有属性。
第三参数 metadata 的 summaries/routes 都可选，是按 Error 引用查询的 WeakMap get 能力。summaries 可给 code/message 对外摘要并隐藏内部 cause；preserveSerializedError: true 才保留该节点既有后代。routes 提供有界路由诊断，不授予控制权限。

toJsonRpcError(wire, code) 把错误树放入 error.data.migaiaWireError；整数 code 由调用方选定，不默认等于 wire code。fromJsonRpcError 也接受无扩展的普通 JSON-RPC 错误，使用 foreignSource `jsonrpc-2.0` 与整数 code 的字符串。RpcJsonRpcWireError.dataKey 维护扩展键。独立适配器使用自己的 source/code，可直接安装 utils 并用 attachErrorIdentity 保留原生错误；不要冒用官方 RPC 身份。
classifyRpcContractError(error) 只按本地对象引用识别本包签发错误，返回对外 code/message；复制或远端还原的错误返回 undefined。远端 source/code 是诊断身份，不证明本地来源，也不授予重试或控制权。

schema/wire-error 只提供结构校验起点，不等于有界 normalizer。独立实现还须执行 x-migaia-limits、canonical base64url、surrogate 等规则；Schema 的 additionalProperties 与 normalizer 默认 reject 并不等价。用其它语言实现原生对端还需长度前缀、握手和 runtime 信封；JSON-RPC 桥还需其四个扩展方法，由 rpc-process 的协议层负责，不由本包完成连接。

blocks.text: serializeRpcError(value, options, metadata?) 的 value 和 options.report 必填；report 接收 `{ pointer, field, error }`，用于被跳过的属性读取或数据规范化失败，不能用次数统计全部截断。它按 source、code、name、message、stack，加可选 cause/errors/data/route/truncated 输出有界错误树；无身份错误使用 unknown/UNKNOWN。跨 realm 原生类型名和发送方 stack 被保留，deserializeRpcError 校验后还原 Error、RangeError、TypeError 等类型，不重新制造发送方 stack。

guidance.id: 保留原生错误类型与远端原因堆栈
guidance.heading: 保留原生错误类型与远端原因堆栈

blocks.text: 远端操作因范围错误而抛出类型错误，接收方需要两层语义码和原始堆栈，才能辨认失败操作及根因。
只发送错误消息会丢掉原因树、原生类型与堆栈，用该文字在本地重建错误，又会生成接收端堆栈并掩盖原始失败位置。
`serializeRpcError` 投影有界带码树，`deserializeRpcError` 校验后恢复原生类型，须提供 `report` 回调以保留无法读取或规范化字段的失败。
`serializeRpcError(value, options)` 两项必填；options.report 是必填同步回调，本例把每个失败记录放入 reports，没有额外默认报告器。source/code 是错误的语义身份，cause 是原始原因。deserializeRpcError 的 options 可省略，未知字段默认 reject。
输出：

blocks.code:
true true
true true
REQUEST LIMIT 0

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `true true`、`true true`、`REQUEST LIMIT 0`，往返保留两种原生类型、两份堆栈字符串和语义码，未报告字段失败。
恢复会创建新的错误对象，不保留跨边界对象身份；错误树有界，可携带 `cause`、聚合错误子项和截断标记，这些函数不建立连接或执行请求。

guidance.id: 报告不可读字段并继续生成线上错误
guidance.heading: 报告不可读字段并继续生成线上错误

blocks.text: 诊断序列化遇到消息访问器会抛错的错误对象，丢弃整条诊断会同时掩盖原操作与新的字段读取失败。
构建 JSON 对象时直接读取属性，会让访问器异常逃出日志路径，若忽略该异常，又会丢失字段被省略的依据。
`serializeRpcError` 捕获支持字段，并把被省略的读取失败交给 `report`；本例先保存错误堆栈，再设置会抛错的消息访问器，收集报告记录供检查。
options.report 的 entry 包含 pointer、field、error；本例 error 是 message getter 的原始失败。第三参数 metadata 未提供，不启用调用方摘要或路由表。Object.defineProperty 是构造本地失败样本，不是 normalizer 的配置项。
输出：

blocks.code:
Error UNKNOWN
1 message true

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `Error UNKNOWN`、`1 message true`，仍返回线上错误，报告指出不可读的消息字段并保留原始 `TypeError`。
`report` 必填，同步收到指针、字段和原始失败；这些记录是本地诊断依据，不是额外线上字段，未编码错误使用未知来源与错误码兜底，不可读字段遵守有界序列化策略。

guidance.id: 错误树-原生类型与-json-rpc-转换
guidance.heading: 错误树、原生类型与 JSON-RPC 转换

blocks.text: serializeRpcError(value, options, metadata?) 的 value 和 options.report 必填；report 接收 `{ pointer, field, error }`，用于被跳过的属性读取或数据规范化失败，不能用次数统计全部截断。它按 source、code、name、message、stack，加可选 cause/errors/data/route/truncated 输出有界错误树；无身份错误使用 unknown/UNKNOWN。跨 realm 原生类型名和发送方 stack 被保留，deserializeRpcError 校验后还原 Error、RangeError、TypeError 等类型，不重新制造发送方 stack。

RpcWireErrorLimit：maxNesting 48、maxEmbeddingDepth 16、maxNodes 1024、maxStringBytes 65536、maxBytes 1048576。超预算或文本截断会裁掉内容并标 truncated；不保证每次裁剪都 report。循环边被裁去；reachRpcError(value, { report }) 遍历 cause、errors 与 cleanup 错误并按引用去重，RpcErrorReachLimit.maxObjects 为 4096。

normalizeRpcSerializedError(value, options?) 的 options 默认空对象；unknownFields 为 reject（默认）或 ignore，onUnknownField 可选、无默认 callback。deserializeRpcError(value, options?, routes?) 采用相同规则，routes 可接调用方 WeakMap 的 set 能力保存已接纳路由。序列化读取固定字段，某字段 getter 失败可报告并保留根、设置 truncated；不承诺读取错误对象的所有任意自有属性。
第三参数 metadata 的 summaries/routes 都可选，是按 Error 引用查询的 WeakMap get 能力。summaries 可给 code/message 对外摘要并隐藏内部 cause；preserveSerializedError: true 才保留该节点既有后代。routes 提供有界路由诊断，不授予控制权限。

toJsonRpcError(wire, code) 把错误树放入 error.data.migaiaWireError；整数 code 由调用方选定，不默认等于 wire code。fromJsonRpcError 也接受无扩展的普通 JSON-RPC 错误，使用 foreignSource `jsonrpc-2.0` 与整数 code 的字符串。RpcJsonRpcWireError.dataKey 维护扩展键。独立适配器使用自己的 source/code，可直接安装 utils 并用 attachErrorIdentity 保留原生错误；不要冒用官方 RPC 身份。
classifyRpcContractError(error) 只按本地对象引用识别本包签发错误，返回对外 code/message；复制或远端还原的错误返回 undefined。远端 source/code 是诊断身份，不证明本地来源，也不授予重试或控制权。

schema/wire-error 只提供结构校验起点，不等于有界 normalizer。独立实现还须执行 x-migaia-limits、canonical base64url、surrogate 等规则；Schema 的 additionalProperties 与 normalizer 默认 reject 并不等价。用其它语言实现原生对端还需长度前缀、握手和 runtime 信封；JSON-RPC 桥还需其四个扩展方法，由 rpc-process 的协议层负责，不由本包完成连接。

id: Application or protocol-owner correlation identifier; preserve it on replies and controls for the same task.

outputEncodedType: Carrier domain yielded after reassembly, independent from physical fragment objects.
frame: Synchronously partitions one encoded value or returns a whole-frame value when no fragmentation is needed.

close: Idempotently closes reassembly, revoking each timer before cancellation so synchronous reentry cancels it once, and drops incomplete messages.
close.reason: Optional caller close reason; built-in framers do not encode or transmit it.

chunkBytes: Positive safe-integer fragment size: bytes for binary, UTF-16 code units for strings; cannot exceed maxMessageBytes.
`16384` units per fragment.
maxMessageBytes: Positive safe-integer size ceiling for complete inbound/outbound values and reassembly; string counts UTF-16 code units, binary counts bytes. Cannot exceed maxBufferedBytes.
`16777216` encoded units per message.
maxChunks: Positive safe-integer maximum declared fragments for one message.
`4096` fragments per message.
maxBufferedBytes: Positive safe-integer total retained incomplete data across all source/message pairs.
`67108864` retained encoded units.
maxConcurrentMessages: Positive safe-integer maximum simultaneous incomplete source/message assemblies.
`256` concurrent incomplete messages.
assemblyTimeoutMs: Positive safe-integer timer deadline after the first fragment before marking its assembly expired.
